title: MEET YOUR NEW BEST FRIENDS: THE COMPANION PETS OF BRAINLYHQ
excerpt: Did you know you can unlock unique companion pets to boost your progress on BrainlyHQ? From Ollie's treasure memory to the limited-time seasonal wolf, Lucy, discover how each pet works and which companion best matches your activity style.
body:
## **Companion Pets in the Ecosystem**

The Brainly Core bot powers a variety of gamification systems designed to reward active members. Among the most popular features are **Companion Pets** - wspecial virtual sidekicks that provide unique passive and active boosts to your daily experience and economy earnings.
Choosing the right companion can significantly optimize your progression across the server. Here is a complete breakdown of the available pets and their special abilities.

## **The Lineup and Abilities**

- **Lucy (The Seasonal Night Wolf):** A predatory night wolf that collects coins faster than anyone else! She costs 700 coins, but her _Night Harvest_ ability allows you to receive up to 10 coins every 12 hours. The earlier you buy her, the bigger your overall profit, but hurry - this is a limited offer and she is only available until the end of September!
- **Ollie (The Treasure Seeker):** A friendly elephant with an incredible memory for treasures. His _Coin Collector_ ability increases the amount of coins earned from economy activities (such as `/work`, `/crime`, and `/hustle`) by a 1.4x multiplier.
- **Kaya (The Energy Saver):** A calm panda and master of resource management. Her _Frugality_ ability reduces overall economic costs by 5% for every item.
- **Sasha (The Steady Saver):** A patient turtle who plans ahead. Her _Stable Income_ ability generates a reliable passive income of 50 coins per month stored directly in savings.
- **Mi Fuego (The Profit Igniter):** A fiery phoenix that can boost daily earnings. Using the `/fuego-power` command once per day activates _Profit Burn_, which doubles coins earned from activities for 1 hour and adds a flat +2 coins to every role income.
- **Sally (The Fast Learner):** A curious cat who absorbs knowledge quickly. Her _Experience_ ability increases all XP earned from economy and progression systems by 1.3x.
- **Fifma (The Lucky Scout):** A clever fox who always spots golden opportunities. Her _Lucky Strike_ ability increases the chance of receiving better loot and higher reward tiers in crates and giveaways by 1.3x.

## **How to Choose Your Companion**

Your choice of pet depends on how you spend your time on BrainlyHQ:

- If you want to take advantage of the current season and maximize your short-term coin generation, grab **Lucy** before September ends!
- If you focus on leveling up your server rank and gaining XP, **Sally** is the ideal partner.
- If you run regular commands and engage with daily tasks, **Ollie** or **Mi Fuego** will maximize your active coin gains.
- If you prefer a casual, low-maintenance approach, **Sasha** ensures steady monthly rewards in the background.

![](/assets/images/blog/gamee.jpg)

**Check your current inventory, explore the shop, and bring your favorite companion along on your BrainlyHQ journey!**
